I find unfortunately over the past six years, there's been changes to this place that's led to a degradation in quality and service. Please fix your booking system. I've been a long standing customer and your new updates have made appointments very cumbersome and inefficient.

In the past, you were able to seamlessly book with specific vets and at specific times. Appointment approved instantly. Great.

They must have cut costs and downgraded their system. Now, you have to submit an appointment "request" and when you write specific notes like the reason for booking the appointment or if your preference is for any time on Friday, they will book you in for whatever date and time is most convenient for them (i.e. Tuesday vs Friday) and not even look at your preferences or bother calling you to confirm they can switch your dates.

I brought my kitten here on May 6th for her first appointment with me as a new pet owner. She had already received her first set of vaccines before coming home, but she was due for her next round. This was my first time navigating vet care on my own, and I had also just moved to the area, so I was honestly a bit stressed going into it.

I ended up getting lost on the way and called ahead to let them know. Even though I was late, they were still able to accommodate my appointment, which I really appreciated since I assumed I would need to reschedule.

From the moment I arrived, the reception staff were kind, welcoming, organized, and social. It was such a breath of fresh air during what I expected to be a stressful experience for both me and my kitten.

I saw Dr. Sherry, and both she and her tech were incredibly thorough. They asked detailed questions about my kitten’s diet, stool, behavior, and overall health, and they carefully walked me through every procedure she would need during this visit and at future appointments, including why each one mattered. I never felt rushed or left in the dark.

They also took the time to explain how to recognize a healthy body weight, gums, and stool, as well as what normal vs. abnormal post-vaccine side effects could look like. They answered all of my questions about diet, teeth, nail grooming, and general kitten care without making me feel silly for asking.

What stood out most was how calm, patient, and gentle they were with my kitten throughout the entire visit. They made the experience feel seamless and positive for her, which I know will make future vet visits easier as she grows up (fingers crossed!).

The level of care and professionalism they showed, even while accommodating me after arriving late, really speaks to the standards they hold themselves to.

After the appointment, they also sent a very detailed follow-up email with additional information, helpful links, and a reminder that they were only a phone call or email away if I had more questions.

Thank you so much to Dr. Sherry and the team at Wellesley Animal Hospital!

I recently visited Wellesley Animal Hospital with my newly adopted cat, Nacho, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the moment we arrived, the team was welcoming and professional. The receptionists downstairs, especially Victoria who I ended up communicating with the most, greeted us warmly and directed us upstairs to the clinic.

Bonnie, who first interacted with Nacho, was incredibly calm and kind, which helped put both of us at ease. Dr. Sherry was exceptionally patient, explained everything clearly and performed a gentle and thorough head-to-tail assessment. Both Bonnie and Dr. Sherry took the time to address all my questions and concerns, providing reassurance, which I greatly appreciated as a first-time cat owner. Dr. Sherry also shared additional resources and never pushed unnecessary services, allowing me to make informed decisions. I opted for the senior wellness package and added a fecal test.

I also really value their use of technology: invoices emailed directly, insurance claims submitted on my behalf, and an app for appointment and vaccination reminders.

Overall, I expected the visit to be much more expensive than it was, and I am extremely happy with my decision to bring Nacho to Wellesley Animal Hospital. The staff’s kindness, professionalism, outstanding communication, and attention to both pet and owner make this clinic amazing.
